is_anopheles.evidence: Page 1: 'All Anopheles mosquitoes were morphologically identified... sub-samples of An. gambiae and An. funestus examined by PCR to distinguish morphologically-similar siblings.'

reports_target_markers.evidence: Page 10: 'Knock down resistance (kdr) assays were not assessed, but a previous study done in villages in the neighboring Ulanga district indicated absence of kdr mutation genes [50].'

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype data for resistance markers is provided in the text, tables, or figures; the study focuses on species identification and sporozoite detection.

african_field_population.evidence: Page 1: 'This study was conducted in Ifakara town and its adjacent wards located in the Kilombero river valley, in south-eastern Tanzania.'

is_primary_study.evidence: The paper describes original entomological field collections and laboratory analysis (ELISA, PCR, bioassays) conducted between 2015 and 2016.

sub_country_location.evidence: Page 2: 'The Ifakara town area is administratively divided into five wards, namely Ifakara Mjini (Ifakara town centre), Katindiuka, Lipangalala, Mlabani and Viwanja Sitini.'

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Page 1: 'Mosquitoes were trapped nightly or monthly (June.2015–May.2016)'.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Routine entomological surveillance conducted by the authors in Ifakara town.

supplement.evidence: The text explicitly states that kdr assays were not performed, so no supplementary genotype data is expected.

assessment.summary: The study assesses malaria transmission intensity and insecticide susceptibility in Ifakara, Tanzania. While it reports phenotypic resistance to pyrethroids, DDT, and pirimiphos-methyl in An. arabiensis using WHO susceptibility assays, it does not genotype any insecticide-resistance markers, explicitly stating that kdr assays were not performed.
exclusion_reasons: Does not report genotyping of any target insecticide-resistance markers. The authors explicitly state on page 10 that 'Knock down resistance (kdr) assays were not assessed'.
